cv.name: Niamh Dempsey
cv.headline: Senior Quality Engineer | Medical Devices | CAPA, Validation & EU MDR
cv.summary: Quality engineer with twelve years in Class II and III medical device manufacturing, from moulding floor QC to leading quality engineering for a catheter line. Comfortable owning CAPA, process validation and notified body audits, and happiest working alongside production rather than behind a desk.

experience.title: Sr. QE / Quality Engineering Lead (Grade E4)
bullets: Lead a team of four quality engineers supporting two catheter assembly lines and one cleanroom moulding cell
Owner of the site CAPA board; cut the average CAPA closure time from 94 to 51 days
Prepared the line for EU MDR transition and hosted the BSI surveillance audit with zero major findings
Write and review pFMEAs, control plans and IQ/OQ/PQ protocols for new equipment

experience.title: Quality Engr II
bullets: Supported NPI for a knee implant instrument set through design transfer and first article inspection
Ran supplier audits and SCARs for machining and passivation vendors

experience.title: QA/QC Tech → Associate Quality Engineer
bullets: Moved from incoming inspection to handling customer complaints and non-conformance reports

skills: ISO 13485, EU MDR 2017/745, FDA 21 CFR Part 820
CAPA, NCR, root cause analysis (8D, 5 Whys)
